result.text:
Ute 3 is a day late, so delivery IN-77 lands 12 Nov, not 11 Nov. Four jobs wait on it.
Starting from Ute 3 (vehicle).
1. IN-77 (delivery), via Ute 3 carries IN-77. Ute 3 carries delivery IN-77, which was due 11 Nov.
2. Crew A (crew), via Ute 3 allocated to Crew A. Ute 3 is Crew A's ute, so Crew A loses its vehicle for a day.
3. TES-101 (job), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-101. IN-77 holds stock for TES-101, due 12 Nov. Arriving that day leaves no slack.
4. TES-102 (job), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-102. IN-77 holds the Clipsal Switchboard for TES-102, due 12 Nov. No slack.
5. TES-103 (job), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-103. IN-77 holds the Symo inverter for TES-103, due 13 Nov. One day of slack.
6. TES-104 (job), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-104. IN-77 holds the Backup Switch for TES-104, due 14 Nov. Two days of slack.
7. Maya Chen (customer), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-101, then Maya Chen has job TES-101. Maya Chen is the customer for TES-101, which is at risk.
8. Daniel Wilson (customer), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-102, then Daniel Wilson has job TES-102. Daniel Wilson is the customer for TES-102, which is at risk.
9. Wattle Creek School (customer), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-103, then Wattle Creek School has job TES-103. Wattle Creek School is the customer for TES-103.
10. Red Plains Cattle Station (customer), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-104, then Red Plains Cattle Station has job TES-104. Red Plains Cattle Station is the customer for TES-104.
11. Crew B (crew), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-102, then Crew B assigned to TES-102. Crew B works TES-102 and may wait on the switchboard.
12. Crew C (crew), via Ute 3 carries IN-77, then IN-77 supplies job TES-104, then Crew C assigned to TES-104. Crew C works TES-104, due 14 Nov.
